__chunk.title: 2 This Software and Related Services
paragraphs: 2.1 This Software is an auxiliary tool for live streaming scenarios, providing features such as live streaming, virtual scene setup, AI matting, face effects, and beauty filters. Specific services and features are subject to the actual product display.
2.2 You may only obtain the client through official channels (Apple App Store or Google Play Store). Any risks and losses arising from the use of unofficial versions shall be borne by you.

2.6 Purchases and Subscriptions

2.6.2 Subscription Rules

(1) Auto-renewal: Subscription services will be automatically charged at least 24 hours before the end of the current service period, and the platform system will send renewal reminders. You can view, manage, and cancel auto-renewal at any time by going to your device's "Settings > Account > Subscriptions" page (the path may vary by platform).

(2) Price changes: If we adjust subscription prices, we will provide notice at least 30 days before the new price takes effect through in-app announcements, the official website, or other reasonable means. Price changes will not affect the current subscription period already in effect. Where local law requires additional user consent, we will comply with the law.
(3) Free trial: If a free trial is offered, please turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the trial period ends to avoid being charged.
2.6.3 Regional Refunds and Statutory Withdrawal Rights

(1) Users in the European Union, European Economic Area, and the United Kingdom: In accordance with local consumer protection laws, you have a 14-day statutory right of withdrawal without cause. See the VicastCam Refund Policy for details. Withdrawal and refund requests must be submitted through the official channel (App Store or Google Play) used for your purchase, and refunds are subject to platform rules and local law. If you have used the service during the 14-day cooling-off period, the refund will be calculated proportionally based on actual usage. Once the withdrawal takes effect, your paid usage rights will terminate immediately.

(2) One-time payment and lifetime services: If you explicitly confirm immediate activation of the service and waive the 14-day withdrawal right, the right of withdrawal without cause will no longer apply.
(3) All other regions: Refunds and after-sales issues are primarily governed by the official rules of the platform used for your purchase.
2.6.4 Paid Benefits Usage Rules
(1) Paid services and benefits are for personal use only.
(2) You are prohibited from providing paid benefits to third parties through gifting, lending, renting, reselling, or bulk sharing.
